title: The 10 Best Air Blow Guns
subtitle: Air compressor blow guns for blowoff, drying and cleaning, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A blow gun turns your compressor into a fast way to clear dust, chips and water from parts and tools. We ranked 10 best-sellers from Milton, Flexzilla, JASTIND, Capri Tools, Astro Pneumatic and NEIKO on rating, review volume and features (an OSHA safety nozzle, stated flow or pressure ratings, a metal body and extra nozzles).

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: JASTIND Industrial Air Blow Gun with Brass Adjustable Air Flow Nozzle Kit (JTABG103A)

avoid.name: PNTGREEN Air Blow Gun, 4-Inch Air Nozzle (DG10S-1-NEW)
avoid.flag: Listing text copied from other brands; no ratings
avoid.verdict: A 4-inch blow gun whose description is lifted from other brands' listings, with no pressure, flow or safety information of its own.
reasons: Its bullets repeat the Astro Pneumatic 1717A's 'high-impact plastic body' with a 'built-in hook slot' and 'Female ¼” Npt for All Types of Air Fittings', and Capri Tools' 'Handle is designed with excellent grip for an ergonomic feel'.
It gives no maximum pressure, flow rating or safety-tip information.
It's rated 4.2 stars on 89 reviews. The Astro 1717A it borrows from costs a few dollars more with 1,474 reviews.

buyers_guide.a: OSHA limits compressed air used for cleaning to under 30 PSI if the nozzle is blocked against skin. Safety nozzles vent air sideways so they can't build that pressure. Required at work, smart at home.
Rubber tips won't scratch paint or chrome and seal against holes for blowing out passages. Metal tips are more durable.
Long nozzles reach into engine bays, radiators and machine beds without getting your hand in the way.
Almost all blow guns use a 1/4-inch NPT inlet. Add the plug that matches your hose coupler (industrial, automotive or ARO).
Wear eye protection, never point a blow gun at anyone, and never use it to clean dust off your skin or clothes.
